question: Which night of the week is busiest on average?
sql: SELECT night_of_week, ROUND(CAST(AVG(orders) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_orders, ROUND(CAST(AVG(sales) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_sales FROM analytics.daily_sales GROUP BY night_of_week ORDER BY avg_orders DESC LIMIT 200
